title: Eve of the Purge
next_chapter_hook: The Hour of the Rat approaches, the sect's bell tolls, and a storm of blood and violence is about to sweep through

text.content: When the two pages of the Tianji Record slowly drew close in the Void, that sensation of fate being torn apart made Chen Ji understand instantly—unity was not an ending, but the beginning of a grander chess game. In the instant when golden light and silver radiance intertwined, a vague prophecy emerged in his Mental Sea: Tomorrow at the Hour of the Rat, Tianqing Sect will be drenched in blood. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul trembled slightly on the first page, a low voice resonating in Chen Ji's heart: 'The remnants of the Five Elders have colluded with the external Demonic Path. Tonight is their optimal timing to strike.' Chen Ji opened his eyes—the night sky outside was ink-black, and distant footsteps of patrolling disciples changing shifts echoed. Everything appeared ordinary, yet undercurrents churned beneath. He gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, already having a plan in mind—this game of chess, it's time to end it.

dialogue.content: 'Young Master,' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare gravity, 'this old servant observed the phenomenon following the unity of the Tianji Record and discovered a crucial piece of information—the enemy's main assault time is not the Hour of the Rat, but the Third Quarter of the Hour of the Pig, one hour before the Hour of the Rat. They intend to catch us completely off guard, completing the purge before the sect's bell tolls.'

text.content: Chen Ji furrowed his brow slightly, rapidly calculating in his mind. If the enemy launches a surprise attack at the Third Quarter of the Hour of the Pig, while the sect's bell won't ring until the Hour of the Rat, this means the garrison will be slaughtered without any warning. He immediately activated the Tianji Record's prediction function, discovering that each use would consume 5 Heavenly Fate points, but at this moment he couldn't afford to hesitate. Golden light flickered in his eyes once more, as visions of the next three hours flashed by like a carousel—he saw the faces of the Five Elders' faction, glimpsed Demonic Path cultivators hidden in the sect's Rear Mountain, and spotted an unexpected figure: Han Lie. That genius from the Xuanwu Sect was actually standing alongside the Five Elders.

'Interesting.' A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He knew of Han Lie by reputation—the foremost prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect, with overwhelming Combat Power but simplistic thinking, always dismissive of a minor sect like Tianqing. Now conspiring with the Five Elders' remnants, he must have been promised considerable benefits. Still, the more complex the chess game, the more opportunities for exploitation. The critical issue was conveying this intelligence to the Sect Master's faction before the Third Quarter of the Hour of the Pig, while preserving sufficient trump cards for himself. Mo Xiansheng seemed to read his thoughts, adding: 'Young Master, after the Tianji Record's unity, the foresight duration extends to six hours, but the consumption doubles. Your remaining Heavenly Fate Value is limited—each use requires discretion.'

dialogue.content: 'Understood.' Chen Ji responded gravely, already mapping tonight's course of action in his mind. The Tianji Record's ink automatically manifested on paper, sketching the Five Elders' power distribution—three concealed within the sect's Forbidden Grounds, two lurking in the Elders' Hall. The external Demonic Path's rendezvous point lay in the eastern valley, roughly thirty li from the sect. He had to deliver this intelligence before the Hour of the Pig while ensuring no one learned the information originated from him. Suddenly, knocking came at the door, followed by a familiar voice: 'Chen Ji, the Sect Master summons.' It was Su Qingyao's attendant. Chen Ji's heart stirred—summoning him now, coincidence or deeper purpose? He drew a steadying breath, tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve, and pushed open the door.

text.content: The Tianqing Sect lay shrouded in eerie stillness under the night sky. The usual chatter of night patrol disciples had vanished, replaced by a suffocating oppression. Chen Ji followed the attendant through winding corridors. Each shadowed corner seemed to probe him with unseen gazes. The Five Elders had cultivated their network within the sect for years—these gazes were likely their informants. Mo Xiansheng timely warned: 'Thirty zhang ahead lurks a Golden Core stage scout, not particularly powerful but skilled at concealing presence. If Young Master wishes to remain unidentified, it's best to feign ignorance.' Chen Ji continued walking without pause, yet his gaze subtly swept that shadowy corner—indeed, an extremely faint Spiritual Energy fluctuation. A cold smile formed in his heart as he pressed forward, silently suppressing the Tianji Record's aura to its lowest.

dialogue.content: Just then, a domineering aura suddenly assailed from the side. Chen Ji's form tensed. Looking up, he saw Han Lie's wild, arrogant face looming over him. 'Oh, isn't this the废物 Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect? Late-night wandering—going to snitch on someone?' Han Lie's voice dripped with undisguised mockery, and several Xuanwu Sect disciples behind him burst into laughter. Chen Ji noted Han Lie's spiritual energy felt even more abundant than their last encounter—clearly he'd consumed some heaven-sent treasure—yet an unnatural pallor shadowed his features, a sequela of forcibly elevating his cultivation. It seemed Han Lie had paid dearly for this operation.

choice.prompt: Faced with Han Lie's provocation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Feign weakness on the surface while secretly memorizing this person's features, waiting for future settlement. Fits the废物 persona, drawing no suspicion.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes minimal time, likely to be looked down upon
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low profile, conceal trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, a fearful smile spreading across his face: 'Han-shixiong jokes, young brother merely goes to the Elders' Hall to fetch tomorrow's alchemy materials under orders—how would I dare engage in snitching?' His tone reached the lowest pitch of servility, perfectly embodying that废物 Servant Disciple bullied throughout the sect. Upon seeing this, satisfaction flickered in Han Lie's eyes, and he coldly harrumphed: 'Smart of you. Get lost, don't delay this young master's business.' Then he swaggered away. Several surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples tacked on their own mockery before following Han Lie into the darkness. Once their figures vanished completely, the fear on Chen Ji's face dissolved instantly, replaced by a chilling intent. He silently resolved: 'Remembered. Once tonight's drama concludes, we'll settle this debt.'

result_nodes.description: Strike back at Han Lie with scathing words, embarrassing him publicly. Satisfying but risks revealing one's edge.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May attract more attention, startling the snake
result_nodes.risk_hint: Han Lie may retaliate on the spot

dialogue.content: A subtle curve appeared at Chen Ji's lips, a barely perceptible cold glint flashing in his eyes before shifting to an innocuous smile: 'Han-shixiong's prestige extends far and wide—young brother has long heard of it. I merely wonder whether the senior's late-night visit to Tianqing Sect is for hospitality... or to serve as someone's blade?' He deliberately emphasized the word 'blade.' Han Lie's expression instantly darkened, a killing intent flickering in his eyes. The disciples behind him started to flare up, but Han Lie raised a hand to halt them, his tiger-like gaze fixed on Chen Ji: 'What do you mean by that?' Chen Ji shrugged innocently: 'Nothing particular, young brother merely asks casually. After all... some people, though possessing profound cultivation, still choose to be another's sword—truly pitiful.'

result_nodes.description: Appease Han Lie on the surface while secretly using the Tianji Record to probe his weaknesses, storing leverage for future use.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Obtaining intelligence on Han Lie's fatal weakness
result_nodes.risk_hint: Risk of the opponent detecting abnormal spiritual fluctuations

text.content: Chen Ji maintained a humble smile, but in his mind he quietly activated the power of the Tianji Record. A hidden spiritual fluctuation emerged from his brow center, silently probing toward Han Lie. After a moment, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly—he had found it. Within Han Lie's Mental Sea remained an extremely concealed restriction, a technique from Xuanwu Sect's higher-ups. Should Han Lie have any rebellious intent or leak information, the restriction would automatically detonate. This meant Han Lie was merely a chess piece placed here by Xuanwu Sect, disposable at any moment. Moreover, Han Lie had recently forced a breakthrough in his realm, leaving his foundation unstable. If subjected to spiritual attacks, he would easily fall into demonic deviation. Chen Ji firmly memorized this intelligence, while on the surface he respectfully stepped aside: 'Senior brother, please. I shall take my leave first.' Han Lie snorted coldly, not bothering to care about this 'waste,' and departed with his subordinates. The crisis was temporarily resolved. Chen Ji continued toward the Elder's Court, but in his heart he already had his own plans.

Inside the Elder's Hall, lanterns blazed brightly. As Chen Ji was led into the main hall, he discovered Sect Master Su Qinghe in secret discussion with several core elders. Su Qingyao stood beside her father, and upon seeing Chen Ji enter, her beautiful eyes flickered with complex emotions—scrutiny mixed with concern. Chen Ji bowed his head in deference, presenting an appearance of sincere fear and reverence. The Sect Master spoke in a heavy voice: 'Chen Ji, we summoned you tonight to inquire about something.' He paused, his gaze sharp as an eagle's: 'Do you know what the remnant forces of the Fifth Elder have been up to lately?' Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression showed only bewilderment: 'Disciple... disciple is merely a servant disciple. How could I possibly know about the elders' affairs?' The Sect Master's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, seemingly judging the truth of his words. Just then, hurried footsteps sounded outside the door. A disciple tumbled in: 'Sect Master! Large numbers of Demonic Path cultivators have been detected in the eastern valley, moving toward the sect!'

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, Su Qingyao's expression sharpened. She had already sensed the undercurrents flowing through the sect tonight, and this news confirmed her hidden worries. She stepped forward, her voice cold and clear: 'Father, if the Fifth Elder's remnants collude with external Demonic cultivators, tonight would be their best opportunity to strike. We must preemptively set our defenses.' The Sect Master pondered for a moment, his gaze falling on Chen Ji once more, seemingly trying to discern any clues from his face. Chen Ji knew this was the critical moment—he had to make the Sect Master believe the warning's authenticity, yet could not expose his secret of possessing the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his heart: 'Young master, Su Qingyao is currently your most trustworthy ally, but her trust has not yet reached the critical threshold. You need to make a choice tonight: continue maintaining your mysterious veil, or reveal part of the truth to her?'

choice.prompt: Faced with the scrutiny of the Sect Master and Su Qingyao, what choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.description: Using 'clues discovered unintentionally' as a pretext, inform the Sect Master's faction of the enemy's general attack time, without mentioning the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the Sect Master to inquire about the source
choices.visible_reward: Help the sect preemptively set defenses, reducing casualties tonight
choices.risk_hint: If pressed too deeply, may expose vulnerabilities

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, as if making some determination, and spoke: 'Sect Master, though I am humble, during my time in the sect I did hear some rumors.' He pretended to hesitate, glancing at the surrounding disciples, then lowered his voice: 'Disciple once inadvertently heard people from the Fifth Elder's faction mention something about "striking at the Hour of Hai" and "catching them off guard." At the time, disciple thought it was merely drunk talk and dared not take it seriously. Now, considering it...' He didn't continue, but the implication was obvious. The Sect Master exchanged glances with the elders, their eyes simultaneously flashing with sharp light. Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes flickered slightly; her gaze toward Chen Ji held more profound meaning—this废物 servant seemed far more formidable than she had imagined. The Sect Master spoke in a grave voice: 'Send the order—entire sect enters first-level combat readiness. All disciples cancel leave. Law Enforcement Hall, full mobilization and standby!'

choices.description: Continue playing the role of a废物, do not proactively provide information, letting the Sect Master's faction make their own judgment.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for preemptive defense
choices.visible_reward: Completely hide the secret of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If the sect suffers severe damage, Chen Ji may bear indirect responsibility

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, assuming a look of confusion and helplessness, as if he were truly nothing more than a frightened servant disciple. The Sect Master, finding nothing useful from his questioning, waved him off to leave. As he departed, Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on his back for a moment, seemingly lost in thought. Outside the Elder's Hall, Chen Ji exhaled a long breath. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his heart: 'Young master chose a conservative strategy, which is perfectly acceptable. After all, in this world, those who know less often live longer. It's just...' He paused: 'If the sect suffers heavy losses tonight, will you feel some guilt in your heart?' Chen Ji paused mid-step, a bitter smile curling at the corner of his mouth. Of course he wished for the sect's safety, but compared to exposing the Tianji Record's secret, what was a little guilt? Besides, he had done his best—that hint about 'striking at the Hour of Hai' was already his limit. The rest would depend on the Sect Master's faction's fortune.

The night wind grew cooler. Less than two hours remained until the Hour of Hai. Chen Ji returned to his secluded dwelling but did not rest. Instead, he lit a solitary lamp, and from his bosom took out the fused Tianji Record fragments. Golden and silver intertwined light flowed across the paper's surface. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly manifested from the first page, several degrees more solid than before. 'Young master,' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of relief, 'after the Tianji Record fused, this old one's power has somewhat recovered. Tonight, this old one can do three things for the young master: First, conceal the Tianji Record's aura, preventing detection by enemy powerhouses; Second, briefly disrupt the enemy's predictions, buying our side the advantage; Third...' He paused: 'Should the young master encounter lethal danger, this old one can burn his own remnant soul to shield you from one fatal blow.' Upon hearing this, warmth surged in Chen Ji's heart. This mysterious remnant soul, from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, had been secretly guarding him. He softly said: 'Mo Xiansheng, tonight you need only accomplish the first two tasks. The third matter—I, Chen Ji, am not foolish enough to let someone from my own side sacrifice themselves.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng hearing this, let out a low chuckle: 'Young master truly values sentiment and loyalty. This old one did not misjudge you.' His figure flickered in the lamplight: 'However, this old one has another matter to inform the young master—after the Tianji Record fused, what manifested was not merely prophecy, but also a segment of sealed memory.' Chen Ji's heart pounded: 'What memory?' Mo Xiansheng slowly said: 'It concerns the final arrangement of Lord Chen Xuan before his fall.' He waved his hand, and a hazy light-image rose from the paper's surface, forming a blurred scene—a setting from twenty years ago, with a young man bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji standing at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, behind him countless corpses of powerhouses. That youth, drenched in blood yet laughing wildly: 'Ling Yuan, you think killing me will get you the Tianji Record? Foolish! I have already sent away the Tianji Record's inheritor. Twenty years later, he will return to take your life!' The scene ended abruptly at that point. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—that youth must be his father, Chen Xuan, and the 'Ling Yuan' mentioned was precisely the current elderly Sect Master of Tianqing Sect!

text.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at the dissipating scene, his fists unconsciously clenching tight. Twenty years ago, Chen Xuan was harmed by Ling Yuan, the Tianji Record's inheritance断了, and he—this '废物'—from the very beginning was merely a chess piece in his father's layout. Mo Xiansheng's voice低沉响起：'Young master, Lord Chen Xuan's arrangement extended far beyond this. The reason Ling Yuan has never acted against you is because he was waiting for a timing—waiting for the Tianji Record to fully awaken, then harvesting it all at once. Only he did not expect the Tianji Record's fusion speed to be much slower than he anticipated.' Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions. He should have realized long ago—that old man who showed him such 'considerate care,' from the start had never meant well. Mo Xiansheng continued: 'Tonight's purge, superficially the rebellion of the Fifth Elder's remnants and external Demonic forces, in reality is very likely being manipulated by Ling Yuan from behind the scenes. He intends to use this opportunity to eliminate the Sect Master's faction, while simultaneously framing the Demonic forces. Finally, he will appear as the 'savior,' completely taking control of Tianqing Sect.'

dialogue.content: Just then, an aged yet majestic voice came through the window: 'Chen Ji, burning a lamp so late at night—what shameful deed are you engaged in?' Chen Ji's hair stood on end—it was Ling Yuan! That old fox had actually come personally. He swiftly tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve, rose to open the door, his face breaking into a panicked smile: 'Disciple... disciple was merely reviewing foundational alchemy knowledge. Nothing shameful, I swear.' Outside the door, Ling Yuan wore a azure robe, his beard and hair entirely white, looking benevolent and kind, like an amiable immortal. But Chen Ji knew well—that kind facade concealed a heart as venomous as a serpent's. Ling Yuan's gaze swept across the room, seemingly searching for something, finally lingering on Chen Ji's slightly bulging sleeve, a gleam of sharpness flashing in his eyes. 'Oh? Reviewing alchemy knowledge?' He smiled cordially: 'Then what have you hidden in your sleeve? Take it out and let this old one have a look.'

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's pressing inquiry, Chen Ji must make a choice

choices.description: Disperse the Tianji Record's aura, letting Mo Xiansheng take the main portion while keeping only the most insignificant fragment for himself.
choices.visible_cost: Consumed Mo Xiansheng's vast amount of power
choices.visible_reward: Protect the core secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might see through the Illusion Clone Technique

text.content: Chen Ji's heart pounded like drums, but his expression remained unchanged. He slowly took out a yellowed old book from his sleeve and respectfully presented it: 'Reporting to the Ancestor, this is the 'Beginner's Alchemy Manual' borrowed from the scripture collection. I was about to review it carefully, not daring the slightest negligence.' Ling Yuan took the book and flipped through a few pages, his brow slightly furrowing—this was indeed a genuine alchemy classic, bearing the unique seal of the scripture collection. But he didn't stop there; instead, he probed with his divine sense, trying to find any hidden restrictions or spaces. Meanwhile, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's sleeve, controlled by Mo Xiansheng, turned into a thread of golden-silver light, silently slipping through the window cracks and merging into the night. Ling Yuan's divine sense swept past that space, his brow slightly creasing—he seemed to sense something unusual, but it vanished in an instant, impossible to confirm. Finally, he snorted coldly and threw the book back to Chen Ji: 'Since you're studying diligently, I'll let it go. However...' He glanced meaningfully at Chen Ji. 'It's almost the Hour of Hai, you'd better not wander about.'

choices.description: Directly reveal that I already know Ling Yuan's conspiracy, using words to force the other party not to act rashly.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of my trump card, completely breaking with Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate Ling Yuan, buying time to catch my breath
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might kill me on the spot to silence me

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, looked up to face Ling Yuan directly, the timidity in his eyes gradually fading, replaced by a sharpness completely at odds with his 'waste' persona: 'Ancestor, your late-night visit, surely not just to check if I was studying diligently?' Ling Yuan's brow lifted slightly, seemingly surprised by the sudden momentum from this废物 servant. Chen Ji continued: 'Twenty years ago, Chen Xuan was your senior brother. The inheritance of the Tianji Record should have fallen to you, but Chen Xuan got there first. You killed Chen Xuan, but didn't obtain the Tianji Record, because the inheritor had already been sent away.' Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, a terrifying pressure filling the air. But he didn't strike—because he knew that if he killed Chen Ji now, the Tianji Record might disappear again. Moreover, he still needed Chen Ji to activate the full power of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji coldly smiled: 'Ancestor, you're waiting, and so am I. Tonight's play, we both know the score.'

choices.description: Pretend to be terrified and incoherent, making Ling Yuan believe I know nothing and just happened to say those words.
choices.visible_reward: Make Ling Yuan lower his guard
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might silence him because he knows too much

text.content: Chen Ji's mind raced, then suddenly he 'thudded' to his knees, trembling like a sieve: 'S-Spare my life, Ancestor! Your disciple doesn't know what you're talking about! Chen Xuan? The Tianji Record? Your disciple truly doesn't know!' His performance was impeccable, eyes red and tearful, the perfect picture of a frightened coward. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, examining him carefully, his divine sense sweeping over Chen Ji several times, but detecting nothing unusual. Finally, he snorted coldly: 'Bah, what could a废物 servant possibly know?' He turned and left, his figure disappearing into the night. Before departing, his voice drifted back: 'Remember, before the Hour of Hai, don't step outside your door.' Only when Ling Yuan's aura had completely vanished did Chen Ji slowly rise, the panic on his face instantly gone, replaced by a cold, sinister smile. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his heart: 'Young master's acting is superb; that old fox Ling Yuan was completely fooled. However... his suspicions about you probably won't disappear just like that.'

Almost the Hour of Zi, the sect's bell was about to toll. Chen Ji stood before the window, gazing at the dark mass of the Rear Mountain in the distance, silently calculating the time. The Tianji Record Fragment had returned to his hand, and Mo Xiansheng's figure had re-entered its first page. The confrontation with Ling Yuan had been perilous, but it confirmed one thing: Ling Yuan was indeed the mastermind behind tonight's conspiracy, and he hadn't acted because he had too many concerns. That old fox wanted to make him a scapegoat? Not so easily. At that moment, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated intensely, and Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: 'Young master, the enemy has moved ahead of schedule! Not the Hour of Hai and the third quarter, but now! Demonic Path cultivators in the eastern valley have begun their assault, while the remnants of the Five Elders are simultaneously launching rebellion within the sect!' Chen Ji's pupils contracted—half an hour ahead of schedule. What did this mean? It meant the Sect Master's faction likely hadn't finished their preparations! Outside the window, flames lit up the sky, war cries shaking the earth. Tianqing Sect's peaceful night had been thoroughly shattered.

Chen Ji swiftly pushed open the door and immediately ran into several panicked servant disciples. Upon seeing Chen Ji, they first froze, then someone shrieked: 'Chen Ji! The Demonic Path has broken through! The Five Elder's people are massacring disciples in the Inner Sect! What do we do?' Chen Ji glanced at them, his voice steady: 'Stop panicking! The Sect Master had prepared for this. Everyone, follow me to the Martial Arena to gather—that's the safest place.' His voice wasn't loud, but carried an undeniable authority, causing those panicked servant disciples to instinctively choose to believe. Mo Xiansheng praised: 'Young master handles situations well; remaining composed in crisis, stabilizing people's hearts with just a few words.' Chen Ji led the group toward the Martial Arena, with more disciples joining along the way, quickly forming a sizable stream. Passing through a corridor, intense fighting suddenly echoed ahead, followed by a familiar figure flying out from around the corner, crashing heavily into the wall—it was Su Qingyao's personal maid, now drenched in blood, barely breathing. She caught sight of Chen Ji and with great difficulty forced out a few words: 'Young miss... trapped in... the Elders' Hall...' Before she could finish, she collapsed, unconscious.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly narrowed. Su Qingyao trapped in the Elders' Hall? That was the core area where the Sect Master resided—if anything happened to Su Qingyao, the Sect Master's faction would surely be thrown into chaos. Various possibilities flashed through his mind, and finally he made a decision through gritted teeth. Mo Xiansheng frantically said: 'Young master, you can't go! The Elders' Hall must be a key attack target right now—with your cultivation level, going there is suicide!' Chen Ji's footsteps didn't slow: 'Su Qingyao is my only ally within Tianqing Sect. If she dies, I'll truly be isolated in this sect. Moreover...' He paused: 'She was the only one who suspected me but ultimately chose to trust me. This trust, I cannot betray.' Without looking back, he led that group of servant disciples, changing direction and heading straight for the Elders' Hall. In the night, flames reflected on his resolute face, his eyes burning with determination. Almost the Hour of Zi, the sect's bell rang out, and a bloodstorm was about to sweep through.
